page_template.$comment: Generated at load time from the slot model in klartex/page_templates.py (page_template_schema); see registry.py.

number_format.description: Number format for amounts: 'sv' gives 32 400,00 (default), 'en' gives 32,400.00.

logo.description: Image file (pdf/png) shown in the receipt's top-left corner, aligned with the KVITTO block. A plain file name is looked up via the asset directory (the page template's directory) and cwd.

logo_height.description: Logo height as a LaTeX dimension, e.g. '1cm'.

logo_offset.description: Fine-tunes the logo position, as fractions of its height: positive x moves right (negative left), positive y moves up (negative down). Starting point: left edge at the margin, top edge aligned with the KVITTO heading.

sender.description: Issuer/seller — shown as the Avsändare block in the receipt body. Give the company's legal name here even when a logo/footer is present.

footer.description: The receipt footer: company, contact and payment details on every page.

address.description: Postal address as an array with one line per element, e.g. ['Storgatan 1', '123 45 Stad'] — line-broken like a postal address. A string renders as a single line.

seat.description: Registered seat of the board, e.g. 'Malmö'

f_tax.description: true shows the line 'Godkänd för F-skatt' (approved for F-tax)

total_amount.description: Total amount paid. Authoritative — never computed from items.

items.description: What was paid for. Amounts are optional and informational — total_amount is the authoritative total.
